diagnostics.title: Diagnostic Evaluations
diagnostics.p1: Our comprehensive diagnostic evaluations provide clarity and understanding for families navigating developmental concerns. We combine evidence-based assessment tools with clinical expertise to deliver detailed, actionable insights.
diagnostics.highlight: Understanding is the first step toward meaningful progress.
diagnostics.p2: Our evaluations are thorough, compassionate, and focused on providing families with the information they need to make informed decisions about their child's development and care.

behavioral.title: The Navara Behavior Method
behavioral.p1: We provide personalized behavior support services that address the unique needs of each child and family. Our approach combines proven behavioral strategies with practical, family-centered solutions.
behavioral.highlight: Every behavior tells a story. We help you understand and respond effectively.
behavioral.p2: Our behavior support services are designed to help families develop effective strategies for managing challenging behaviors while promoting positive development and family harmony.

pathways.title: Career Pathways
pathways.p1: Our career exploration program helps young adults discover and pursue meaningful career paths. We combine assessment, guidance, and practical experience to support informed career decisions.
pathways.highlight: Your career journey should reflect your unique strengths and aspirations.
pathways.p2: Through personalized guidance and hands-on experience, we help young adults identify career paths that align with their interests, strengths, and long-term goals.

team.title: OUR TEAM
team.subtext: Meet the dedicated professionals committed to providing exceptional care and support

founder.name: David Nisan Fetman, MA, BCBA
founder.introSentence: David Nisan Fetman, known as Nisan, is a Board Certified Behavior Analyst, clinical leader, and psychology doctoral candidate with nearly a decade of experience in behavioral healthcare. His work spans behavioral science, clinical psychology, and the intersection of research, clinical practice, and innovative treatment approaches.
founder.fullText:
David Nisan Fetman, known as Nisan, is a Board Certified Behavior Analyst, clinical leader, and psychology doctoral candidate with nearly a decade of experience in behavioral healthcare. His work spans behavioral science, clinical psychology, and the intersection of research, clinical practice, and innovative treatment approaches.

Currently pursuing his doctorate in psychology and a second master’s degree in clinical psychopharmacology, Nisan is also working toward the BCBA-D designation, reflecting his commitment to advanced clinical training and professional excellence.

Throughout his career, Nisan has developed a reputation for challenging conventional approaches, bringing fresh perspectives to complex clinical challenges, and translating behavioral science into practical, meaningful interventions. In addition to founding Navara Behavioral Group, he serves as Chief Clinical Director of Archways ABA, providing clinical leadership and helping shape standards of care across the organization.

Nisan founded Navara with a vision that extends beyond traditional behavioral services: to rethink how families receive support, place parents at the center of meaningful change, and bridge the gap between clinical expertise and everyday life. At the heart of his approach is a simple conviction: lasting change begins with understanding, and connection comes before compliance.

members.name: Laya Milstein, MPS
members.introSentence: Laya is known for her creative, compassionate, and deeply relational approach to supporting children and families.
members.fullText: Laya is known for her creative, compassionate, and deeply relational approach to supporting children and families in both school and home-based settings. She builds lasting connections that foster trust, growth, and collaboration beyond the therapy room. A mother of five with over three decades of parenting experience, Laya brings empathy, insight, and real-world understanding to every interaction. She approaches each case with curiosity and courage—thinking outside the box to find what truly works. Laya holds a Master's in Professional Studies and is dedicated to helping every child grow, succeed, and shine.

members.name: Tammy Fetman, M.S.Ed.
members.introSentence: Tammy brings over 27 years of experience as the owner and director of a licensed New York daycare.
members.fullText: Tammy Fetman brings over 27 years of experience as the owner and director of a licensed New York daycare, along with dual master's degrees in early childhood education and special education. She has taught early childhood courses as an adjunct professor at Touro College and has provided extensive parenting guidance to families, supporting children's academic, emotional, and developmental growth. Currently pursuing her LMHC degree, Tammy integrates her expertise in education and counseling to empower parents to become confident advocates for their children's well-being and long-term success.

members.name: Lena Marciano
members.introSentence: Lena is a Board Certified Behavior Analyst with several years of experience supporting children and families through Applied Behavior Analysis.
members.fullText: Lena is a Board Certified Behavior Analyst with several years of experience supporting children and families through Applied Behavior Analysis. As a parent herself, she understands the challenges and rewards of raising children and brings a practical, compassionate approach to her work. Lena is passionate about empowering parents with effective strategies to create positive change at home. Her goal is to help families build connection, confidence, and lasting progress together.

members.name: Brittney Kushner
members.introSentence: Brittney holds a degree in Applied Behavior Analysis with a focus on becoming a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA).
members.fullText: Brittney Kushner holds a degree in Applied Behavior Analysis with a focus on becoming a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). She has experience working with children with special needs and is passionate about helping each child reach their fullest potential. She is compassionate, caring, and easygoing, and strives to create a supportive and positive environment for both children and their families. She believes in building meaningful relationships while using individualized, evidence-based strategies to help children develop important skills and achieve their goals.

members.name: Sarah Manela, OTR/L
members.introSentence: Sarah Manela is a pediatric occupational therapist with over a decade of experience helping children build motor, sensory, and daily living skills.
members.fullText: With over a decade of experience in pediatric occupational therapy, Sarah brings deep expertise, warmth, and creativity to her work with children and families. She specializes in helping kids build the motor, sensory, and daily living skills they need to thrive at home, in school, and in the community. As a mom of four herself, Sarah deeply understands the concerns parents face and brings a strong sense of empathy and partnership to her work. Sarah is passionate about creating playful, personalized interventions that empower children and support caregivers every step of the way.
